Fetal-derived in vitro: cultured primary human neural progenitors and their differentiated neuronal progeny (Aygun 2021 AJHG PMID 34416157).

Childhood- and prenatal-inclusive. eQTL Catalogue BrainSeq QC report: 495 samples before QC, 479 after (no age filter) = the full BrainSeq Phase 1 polyA DLPFC set, which spans second-trimester fetal to 85 y (Jaffe 2018 Nat Neurosci PMID 30050107); only 412 of those 495 donors were aged >13 y, so >=67 of the 479 retained samples are aged <=13 y (fetal/infant/child).
Fetal: 201 mid-gestational human neocortex samples (Walker 2019 Cell PMID 31626773).
